# Posture tiers

Each posture tier maps to one preset: **workshop** is `presets/greenfield.yaml`, **secure** is `presets/security-focused.yaml`, **production** is `presets/production.yaml`. The table lists every security and observability key the presets set, with the raw preset value for each tier. A key a preset does not set is shown as `— (default)`: the platform default applies (see [platform.yaml reference](PLATFORM_YAML.md)). Rows in bold differ between tiers.

| key | workshop | secure | production |
|---|---|---|---|
| **`agents.allowed_models`** | **— (default)** | **`[us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6]`** | **`[us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6]`** |
| **`agents.memory.event_expiry_days`** | **— (default)** | **— (default)** | **`30`** |
| **`deployment.mode`** | **— (default)** | **— (default)** | **`production`** |
| `gateway.tools` | `[sample-tool]` | `[sample-tool]` | `[sample-tool]` |
| **`gateway.web_search`** | **`auto`** | **`auto`** | **`off`** |
| **`identity.client_id`** | **— (default)** | **— (default)** | **`REPLACE_ME`** |
| **`identity.client_secret_name`** | **— (default)** | **— (default)** | **`agentcore/idp-client-secret`** |
| **`identity.idp`** | **`cognito`** | **`cognito`** | **`entra_id`** |
| **`identity.mode`** | **— (default)** | **— (default)** | **`direct`** |
